traceability.evidence: Rule implementation present: src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts defines ESLint RuleModule `require-branch-annotation` with meta.docs.description "Require @story and @req annotations on code branches" and handlers for all configured branch types (IfStatement, SwitchCase, TryStatement, CatchClause, ForStatement, ForOfStatement, ForInStatement, WhileStatement, DoWhileStatement). It uses `reportMissingAnnotations` to detect missing annotations and reports `missingAnnotation` with data `{ missing: '@story' | '@req' }`.,Branch helpers implement detection, comment association, parsing, supports-alternative, nested handling, and configurable scope in src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts: - DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES constant covers if/else, switch, try/catch, and loop constructs (REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION, REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA). - `validateBranchTypes` reads `context.options[0].branchTypes`, validates against DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES, and either returns a filtered list or a Program listener that reports config errors (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE). - `gatherBranchCommentText` uses `sourceCode.getCommentsBefore(node)` plus special handling for SwitchCase, CatchClause, and else-if branches, associating nearby comments with the branch (REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION). - `getBranchAnnotationInfo` calls `gatherBranchCommentText`, detects `@story`, `@req`, and `@supports` via regex, and treats `@supports` as satisfying both story and requirement (REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING, REQ-SUPPORTS-ALTERNATIVE). - `reportMissingStory` and `reportMissingReq` compute indent/insert positions and optionally provide autofixes inserting `// @story .story.md` and `// @req ` above the branch. - `getBaseBranchIndentAndInsertPos` and else-if-specific logic handle nested/formatter-driven layouts, including `CatchClause` bodies and `else if` blocks (REQ-NESTED-HANDLING).,Core rule behavior is comprehensively tested in tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts (all passing per jest run): - Valid cases for all major branch types with proper `@story` and `@req` annotations (if, switch case, try/finally, catch, do-while, for-of, for-in, while) plus nested ifs (e.g. "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] valid if-statement with annotations", "[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] valid switch-case with annotations", "[REQ-NESTED-HANDLING] nested if-statements with annotations on outer and inner branches"). - Valid configurable scope: options `{ branchTypes: ['IfStatement'] }` enforce only that type; non-listed types are ignored ("[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE] custom branchTypes ignores unlisted branch types"). - Alternative format support: valid cases with only `@supports` annotations on if, try/catch, and else-if branches (e.g. "[REQ-SUPPORTS-ALTERNATIVE] if-statement with only @supports annotation is treated as fully annotated"). - Invalid cases confirm detection and autofix for missing annotations on each branch type, including nested and configured-scope scenarios, with expected output snippets showing inserted placeholder comments (e.g. missing annotations on if, loops, switch-case, try/catch, nested inner if, and else-if with Prettier-style insertion).,Configuration error handling is verified by tests in tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts and tests/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.test.ts: - Rule-level test "[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE] invalid branchTypes option should error schema" passes with options `{ branchTypes: ['UnknownType'] }` and expects an error message matching `/should be equal to one of the allowed values/`. - Helper tests for validateBranchTypes assert that with invalid types `['UnknownType', 'Foo']`, the function returns a listener object with Program handler and that `context.report` is called once per invalid type with messages containing `Value "" should be equal to one of the allowed values:` (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE, error handling).,Performance requirement is explicitly tested in tests/perf/require-branch-annotation-large-file.test.ts (passing): - Builds a large source string with 200 functions and nested if-statements (`buildLargeNestedBranchSource`) to create many branch nodes. - Uses ESLint Linter with rule `traceability/require-branch-annotation` and asserts `messages.length > 0` and runtime `< 5000` ms (REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION, REQ-NESTED-HANDLING).,Additional integration and helper tests exercise comment association and nested/formatter edge cases, confirming robust behavior on complex code patterns: - tests/utils/branch-annotation-else-if-position.test.ts and tests/utils/branch-annotation-else-if-insert-position.test.ts verify else-if comment positions and insertion strategy (referenced in require-branch-annotation docs, supporting nested handling and user experience around Prettier). - tests/utils/branch-annotation-catch-position.test.ts & tests/utils/branch-annotation-catch-insert-position.test.ts validate special handling for CatchClause comments before and inside the block. - All these tests passed in the provided `npm test -- --verbose` run, showing stable behavior across complex control-flow layouts (REQ-NESTED-HANDLING, REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION).,Rule is fully wired into the plugin and presets, satisfying integration and quality standards: - src/index.ts includes "require-branch-annotation" in RULE_NAMES so it is dynamically required and exported via `plugin.rules` (dependency on 001.0, 002.0 satisfied). - TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES maps "traceability/require-branch-annotation" to "error", and `createTraceabilityFlatConfig()` surfaces this in the recommended and strict flat-config presets. - tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts (passing) asserts that the recommended and strict presets enable the traceability rules, including branch annotations (Integration and Quality Standards acceptance criteria).,User-facing documentation for this rule exists and is linked to the story: docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md. - Describes purpose: ensuring significant branches have `@story` and `@req` annotations; references `@story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md` and REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION / REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE. - Explains catch-clause and else-if annotation positions, precedence rules, and behavior under formatters like Prettier (aligning with Implementation Notes and edge-case handling). - Documents the `branchTypes` option, default values, allowed values, and the invalid configuration error message format, with examples of correct, incorrect, and misconfigured usage (Documentation acceptance criterion).,Project-wide tests, including all rule, helper, perf, and integration tests, pass: - `npm test -- --verbose` output shows `PASS tests/rules/require-branch-annotation.test.ts`, `PASS tests/perf/require-branch-annotation-large-file.test.ts`, `PASS tests/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.test.ts`, plus related catch/else-if helper and integration tests. - Overall summary: "Test Suites: 1 skipped, 48 passed, 48 of 49 total; Tests: 2 skipped, 359 passed, 361 total" confirming the implemented functionality is stable and regression-tested.
traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS are implemented and verified: - The `require-branch-annotation` rule enforces annotations on significant branches (if/else, switch cases, try/catch, loops) and supports configurable branch types. - Comment association and annotation parsing correctly handle @story, @req, and @supports (alternative format) around branches, including formatter-driven layouts for catch and else-if. - Extensive unit, perf, and integration tests cover core behavior, nested structures, configuration, and performance under large nested-branch files, all passing in the current test run. - The rule is documented with usage, configuration, and examples, and is integrated into the plugin’s recommended/strict presets. Therefore this story is fully implemented and passing.
